scores.rationale: Pinned provenance and minimal integration are strongly verified: HEAD and both fingerprints match the binding, tracked status is clean, the five frozen donors have explicit selective dispositions, and the architecture preserves one canonical authority model without wholesale donor integration.

Exact knowledge graph and no-loss controls are implemented with stable canonical authority, intake-disposition expectations, exact-set checks, and adversarial coverage for missing classifications, unknown references, broken graphs, projection drift, and corpus loss; the bound pre-holdout structure test passes.

Agency and collective-credit integrity is explicit and adversarially guarded: every proof is classified as an exact set, supported action and collective boundaries coexist, and mutations target sole causality, title inflation, collaborator erasure, endorsement drift, and legislative-causality overstatement.

New-operator lifecycle commands are thin canonical-record operators with bounded help, private-marker rejection, nonzero validation behavior, read-only or append-safe semantics, capped queries, compiled leak checks, and an explicit guarantee that intake creates no canonical record or public claim automatically.

Survivorship, rights, and research re-entry are carefully separated: method-specific archive observations remain non-comparable, negative findings stay bounded, protected manifests remain outside Git, rights and consent are not inferred from support, and mutations enforce distinct rights states and non-automatic re-entry.

Selective public composition and mosaic privacy are implemented as route-specific arguments with audiences, intended actions, per-instance claim budgets, selected proofs, and omission rationales; the candidate-bound mosaic review identifies compound disclosure risks and continuing holds, while mutations reject route, omission, render-path, and budget drift.

Evaluator trust, calibration, and unchanged-candidate holdouts are well instrumented: the frozen contract and candidate binding match, self-grading, duplicate scores, stale dates, invented evidence, candidate drift, and malformed receipts are rejected, and only the aggregate may derive a four from two valid independent threes. This receipt cannot prove the unseen peer receipt, so the mandated receipt-level ceiling applies.

Layered verification and release policy are correctly defined and preserve separate source, graph, browser, accessibility, build, runtime, staging, production, and human layers. The bound structural test passes and release escalation is truthful, but the production-readiness checklist still records browser/runtime and production layers as pending, so full launch-level verification is not yet evidenced.

Truthful human and consent gates are enforced: PR-019, PR-025, rights, collaborator consent, production approval, and indexing remain pending human decisions; automated approval and resolved-gate mutations are rejected, and no protocol or AI judgment is represented as consent or release authority.
